Subject: Request: absolute EU-only processing + deletion proof for pilot

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are preparing a short pilot for PHI-adjacent triage and need clear contractual and operational assurances before security signs off. Two specific asks from our legal/compliance team:

1) Can Redwood guarantee that inference and any persistent artifacts (logs, caches, backups) for the MediCore pilot remain processed and stored only within EU jurisdictions (no outbound replication or operator access from non-EU regions)?

2) For deletion: we require a reproducible deletion workflow (including backups) and an attestation timeline we can include in our contract (we're proposing 30 days for primary + 90 days for backups).

Privacy team specifically referenced Schrems II and SCCs — they want to know what proof you can provide (operator access logs, KMS key locality, backup location map, delete runbooks).

Can you send a single package we can hand to legal that contains operational attestations, a timeline, and a list of artifacts you will provide?

Best,
Alice Müller
Privacy Lead — MediCore

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai, Alice Müller <alice.mueller@medicore.de>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 14:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: absolute EU-only processing + deletion proof for pilot

Hi all — technical summary and what we can commit to operationally (short answers first, then detail):

Short answers:
- EU-only processing: yes — inference, cache, logs, and customer artifacts for the MediCore pilot will be confined to the DE-FRA region (no cross-border replication).
- Backups: backups will be stored in-region by default; we can commit to a policy that backup copies remain in EU storage tiers and are not replicated to non-EU regions.
- Operator access: privileged operator sessions are restricted to employees whose work location is EU; remote support from non-EU may be allowed only via documented jump sessions where operator actions are audited.
- Deletion: we can produce an attestation for deletion workflows and run the purge within the 30/90 window you suggested — primary purge (marks + trimming) in 30 days, verified bitmap deletion from backups within 90 days, subject to the normal immutable snapshot windows documented below.

Technical details (for legal/infosec):
1) KMS & keys: customer data encryption uses region-bound KMS keys (we can use Redwood-managed EU keys or provide BYOK where MediCore supplies keys hosted in an EU KMS). We will include a KMS policy export for the keys in the attestation pack.

2) Logs & auditing: all operator actions are retained in an append-only audit store located in DE-FRA. Audit logs include session recordings for privileged sessions, plus per-request access logs with IP and actor identity. We can provide redacted samples and a hash-signed log excerpt to prove immutability.

3) Backups: our backup system keeps incremental snapshots stored in the EU storage pool. For the pilot we will set the replication factor to EU-only. Note: physical media lifecycle and long-term archival are covered — we will include the backup location map (spreadsheet) and an explanation of snapshot retention windows; some archival tiers have a mandatory 14-day immutable window that affects earliest complete purging of deep archival copies.

4) SCCs/Schrems II: SCCs are in place; we will provide an executed SCC annex and our standard set of transfer risk mitigations (technical & contractual). We cannot prevent lawful requests to operators in other jurisdictions where the operator is physically present, but we can limit operator access and provide full access logs and a documented escalation pathway if a production request occurs. This is consistent with typical mitigations customers ask for.

What we'll include in the package we hand you:
- One-page attestation (signed by Redwood security) covering EU processing and deletion commitments.
- KMS policy export and key residency statement (pdf).
- Backup-location map (xlsx) and snapshot retention table.
- Redacted audit log excerpt + signed hash proof (txt).
- Operational deletion runbook (pdf) and estimated timeline for the pilot.

Open items we need MediCore to confirm:
- Do you want Redwood-managed EU keys, or will you provide BYOK? BYOK adds stronger guarantees but requires integration time.
- Are there additional legal hold or eDiscovery requirements that would alter deletion windows?

I will prepare the artifacts and share a Drive folder link for MediCore by Thu 23 Feb CET.

-Naomi
Director, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Attachment: backup-retention-map.xlsx (xls stub)

We have scheduled a dedicated artifact drop for MediCore tomorrow 24 Feb: the packet Naomi outlined (attestation PDF, KMS policy export, backup map, redacted logs, deletion runbook). Delivery will be via a shared, access-controlled Drive link with view-only rights for mediCore legal.

Timeline commitments:

- Pilot start: tenant init in DE-FRA after onboarding (we estimate 3 business days post-signed contract).

If you confirm BYOK is not required, we'll provision with Redwood-managed EU keys and include key identifiers in the packet. If you require BYOK, please share the key handshake preference and a contact for the key escrow team — that adds ~5 business days to onboarding.

I'll add the shared drive link to this thread once the drop is complete.

Thanks — Vivek
